rejected_initial_selection.reason: PH2A rating explicitly referencesAWG24.0.14mm2 fits crimp dimensions but does not establish the rated2A combination; use0.22mm2. LAPP0.25mm2 alternative exceeds SPH-002 stated0.22mm2 upper range.

selected.designation_note: Base article101022 plus manufacturer color suffix07 red/08 black; ordering separator formatting must match vendor catalogue.
selected.PH_rating: 2A withAWG24;100V. Proper crimp and actual temperature rise remain qualification.

resistance_model.limits: Screening includes two PH20mOhm after-test contact values, not added terminal/crimp/PSU/fuse/PCB resistance or guaranteed elevated-temperature assembly resistance. Accept actual complete harness by voltage-drop and temperature measurement.100Ohm/km is selected acceptance requirement, not quoted manufacturer guarantee.

integration: Use only current-limited laboratory PSU, battery disconnected. This is not pack wiring approval.
2A board fuse is neither precise current regulator nor protection for a cable short upstream of the fuse. PSU current limit must be qualified for harness, including output capacitor transients.
Keep original power/light budget.1.4822A is a budget model, not hardware clamp.
Measure BAT_RAW/BAT_FUSED at board under load; cable drop can move apparent PSU-side UVLO threshold. Never compensate above permitted board input voltage.
Longer PSU leads require separate larger-conductor segment and inclusion in voltage-drop measurement;0.15m limit applies each selected thin lead.
Crimp with proper SPH-002 tool/process; verify retention, polarity J1pin1BAT_RAW/J1pin2GND, insulation and strain relief.
